Some of its patrons referred to a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] as the '''Podracer Cantina'''. it was run by an [[Unidentified Ithorian bartender (Tatooine)|Ithorian bartender]] and also boasted a large [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] stored exclusively with [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] information.
